annotations.title: Verify any XDR-1 receipt — free, stateless, any issuer

x402.note: Flat at-cost floor; a cost-linked guard may raise the floor under sustained Base fee spikes (never demand surge). The 402 challenge body is authoritative.

description: Verifies a signed XDR-1 receipt from ANY x402 service: recomputes the canonical digest and recovers the signer, then compares it to the declared signer. Free forever — no account, no quota, no storage (stateless). A valid receipt proves the signer signed that tool call at that timestamp; it does NOT prove funds moved or any business claim.

receipt.description: The full XDR-1 receipt object: v, tool, tool_version, input_hash, output_hash, payer, recipient, amount, nonce, ts, tier, signer, signature (optional successor/stream_state).
